newsitem.title: USA: Amquest to introduce new modem.
newsitem.headline: Amquest to introduce new modem.

text.p: Amquest Corp, a privately held personal-computer enhancement company, said on Thursday that it would launch a new series of modems based on Rockwell International Corp's new 56,000 bits-per-second (bps) modem chipsets.

Rockwell said on Tuesday that it had developed this new modem technology and will be demonstrating its capabilities at the 1996 Comdex show in Las Vegas. Amquest manufactures and sells a complete line of high-speed modems that utilize the Rockwell chipsets.
The new 56 Kbps modems will use a standard telephone line and take full advantage of the digital connection to the telephone network.
